title: Guided tour
intro: Take the full tour of the app on a real demo club: Étoile de la Côte, a Ligue 1 club in Douala, with its four teams, its members, a match coded on its video and pickup games. Each step opens the right page and lights up what to look at.
note: The tour loads the demo in this browser. You can click anywhere during the tour, the card follows you. Nothing is sent.
ownData: This browser already holds your own data. The demo replaces it. To keep it, export it first from Settings.
ownDataGo: Replace with the demo and start
chaptersHint: Each chapter opens the demo at its first step.

home.title: The coach's home
home.body: Every morning, the home page says what matters today: today's session, the next match, the team's Njangi Index. Here, Daniel Mbarga coaches Étoile de la Côte.

guide.title: The guide, on every page
guide.body: This link opens the guide chapter that explains the page you are on, in a new tab. Its number changes with the page.

drills.title: The library of 64 drills
drills.body: Every drill of the Njangi Code, by family: technique, rondos, positional games, small and large games, transitions, finishing. Each one is animated.

drill.title: A drill that moves
drill.body: The diagram plays like a video: passes, runs, carries, step by step. Pause, replay a step, show it to the players on a phone.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.body: A session puts drills together with their minutes and an intention. Mola can prepare one for you.

week.title: The match week
week.body: From MD+1 to MD-1, the load follows the calendar: recovery, tension, duration, speed, activation. Saturday, the match.

roster.title: The squad
roster.body: Twenty-two players with their position, foot, skills and notes. Tap a player for his journey.

player.title: A player's journey
player.body: Dated evaluations, observations, attendance, objectives, match contributions: a player's story over the season.

matchSheet.title: The match sheet
matchSheet.body: Line-up, game plan in five moments, and the yellow button: add the match video to analyse it.

club.title: The club
club.body: All the club's teams in one place: seniors, U19, U17, women. The club's game model, shared by every team, and what each team needs next.

clubMembers.title: Members and their rights
clubMembers.body: Admins, coaches, analysts, players, parents: each sees what concerns them. Invite someone with a link you send yourself.

clubVideos.title: The club video library
clubVideos.body: Every video of every team: matches, training, scouting of opponents. Filter by team, type, source.

clubPlayers.title: Recruitment profiles
clubPlayers.body: Each player can have a public profile: position, foot, height, season numbers and his best clips. Enough to answer a recruiter or a university.

analysis.title: Analysing means coding on the video
analysis.body: Film the match, put the video online, code every action on the video. The page says so from the start.

studio.title: The video studio
studio.body: The match against Météore de Bafoussam, hosted on Ndamba: it plays straight away. The demo video is a 2D animation drawn from the match codes, so every coded action shows on screen.

coding.title: Code an action, with its place
coding.body: One tap on the code, one tap on the mini pitch for the place, one tap on the player's number. That is what feeds the report's maps.

clips.title: Clips
clips.body: Goals and shots get an automatic clip. Make your own with a start and an end, a title, a note, the players involved.

drawing.title: Draw on the picture
drawing.body: Arrows, circles, a spotlight on a player, zones, links between players, text. The annotated image stays attached to the clip.

session.title: The video session
session.body: Five clips in a row, full screen, each with a title and a note: two for what works, two to fix, one to end on the game plan.

ai.title: AI analysis, as an option
ai.body: Claude reads a frame every few seconds and estimates possession, territory, block height and rest defence. Paid, with the players' agreement, it adds to the coding.

report.title: The match report
report.body: The Njangi Index, the five sub-indices, the numbers and what to work on. Every goal can be watched again with one tap.

maps.title: The maps
maps.body: Shot map, passing network, action heat map, defensive actions: every point is a coded action, and a click opens the video at that moment.

players.title: The players of the match
players.body: One card per player, his numbers, his action map, and the player of the match. Compare two players side by side.

assist.title: Ask Mola
assist.body: Sum up the match, our trends, our efficiency in front of goal: Mola reads the codes and answers in a few sentences.

season.title: Maps and season
season.body: Averages of the last ten matches, progress match after match, maps of the whole season and the comparison with each opponent.

filming.title: Film your matches
filming.body: Where to put the camera, how to keep it running for 90 minutes, and the recommended gear, from the Veo Go to a simple tripod.

upload.title: Free link or paid upload
upload.body: A YouTube or Facebook link costs nothing: Ndamba stores nothing. Uploading to Ndamba is paid, with the price shown up front.

pickup.title: Pickup games
pickup.body: The Sunday game without chasing everyone: sign-ups, waitlist, check-in, balanced teams, payments by Mobile Money.

pickupGame.title: The group's next game
pickupGame.body: Open the game: spots left, waitlist, check-in at the pitch, teams to drag on the pitch, who has paid.

mola.title: Mola, the agent
mola.body: Ask for a session, a message to parents, a reminder: Mola prepares it all and sends nothing without your approval.

premium.title: The plans
premium.body: Free, Player, Coach Pro, Club, Federation, plus AI analysis per match and video hosting. Payments are not connected yet: activation is a demonstration.

end.title: You have seen it all
end.body: Stay in the demo as long as you like, or create your own space from Settings. The guide details every page.
